evidence_required_before.independent_semantic_gloss: PRIMARY_ATTESTED or SECONDARY_ATTESTED source root for the specific unit
evidence_required_before.polar_pole: sourced evidence that the unit's root is POLAR (not merely that a root exists) — S1 does not establish this
evidence_required_before.transition_role: a sourced or separately-derived (INFERRED, labelled) compositional rule
evidence_required_before.modifier_role: sourced phonological role (e.g. anusvāra nasalization) — structural, still no meaning
evidence_required_before.context_dependent_realization_rule: a deterministic, pre-registered rule kept distinct from canonical output
